# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Be respectful, constructive, and welcoming. Discuss ideas and code without
personal attacks, harassment, discrimination, intimidation, or the publication
of another person's private information.

Examples of positive participation include giving useful feedback, accepting
corrections gracefully, respecting different experiences, and keeping
discussions focused on the project.

## Scope and enforcement

This standard applies in project spaces and when representing the project in
public. Repository maintainers may edit, remove, or reject contributions and
temporarily or permanently restrict participation when behavior is harmful or
disruptive.

Do not disclose sensitive conduct reports in a public issue. Use GitHub's
private reporting tools when available, or report abusive content directly to
[GitHub Support](https://support.github.com/). Maintainers will review reports
fairly and protect reporters' privacy as far as reasonably possible.
